title: fix(objectql)!: refuse at boot a controlled_by_parent detail whose master the engine cannot compose a read over
body:
Fixes #25144

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

Metadata-protocol: none

## What

A `controlled_by_parent` detail whose master is in one of ADR-0139's two uncomposable classes now refuses the **boot**. Before this change the stack booted, and the id-list pre-scan served it. Once #24932's leaf switch lands, every read of such a detail would answer `INTERNAL_ERROR` / 500. The two classes:

- **(a) D5.3**: a master bound to another datasource than the detail;
- **(b) D5.2**: a master that an object-scoped read middleware narrows (`registerMiddleware(fn, { object })`), for example `sys_attachment`.

The refusal is `INVALID_METADATA` / 422. It names each detail, its master field, the master and the class, plus the three remedies: bind both to one datasource; or choose a master without an object-scoped read middleware; or declare the detail without `controlled_by_parent`. It is one error listing every offender. There is no warn-and-continue, no silent skip and no id-list fallback. The read-time refusal (`refuseUncomposableReadableIdsClasses`) is unchanged, and its messages are byte-identical.

- `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`: the read path's two checks move into one private predicate, `uncomposableReadableIdsParent(object, parent)`. It is `hasObjectMiddleware` and then `resolveDatasourceBinding` on both sides, in the read path's own order. The read refusal and the new public `ObjectQL#findUnservableControlledByParentMasters()` both call it, so the boot rule and the read rule cannot drift. The master is the detail's one required `master_detail` (`isControlledByParentMasterField`, ADR-0055 §1).
- `packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts`: `describeUnservableControlledByParentMasters()`, thrown from `ObjectQLPlugin`'s `kernel:bootstrapped` handler.
- `.changeset/25144-cbp-unservable-master-boot-refusal.md`: BREAKING, `patch` (`Metadata-protocol: none`), with the remedy and the ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

## Placement (measured first)

On `origin/main` `23540582f4`, the kernel runs every `start()`, then `kernel:ready` (handlers in registration order), then `kernel:bootstrapped`, then `kernel:listening`, which opens the socket.

- The engine plugin registers its `kernel:ready` handler in its own `start()`, so that handler runs **before** its dependents' handlers.
- Most of the card's object-scoped read middlewares are registered **inside the owning plugin's `kernel:ready` handler**, not in `start()`:
  - service-mailbox: `installMailReadVisibility`;
  - plugin-audit: comment, activity, activity redaction, audit-log redaction, audit-log visibility;
  - service-storage: `installAttachmentReadVisibility`.
- plugin-approvals and plugin-security register theirs in `start()`.
- No object-scoped registration runs in any `kernel:bootstrapped` or `kernel:listening` handler. I grepped every one of them: sharing, security, auth, automation, mcp, pinyin, storage, organizations.

So `registerApp` sees neither final fact, and the engine's `kernel:ready` sees the bindings but not the later middlewares. `kernel:bootstrapped` sees both and is still a boot refusal, because no socket is open yet. The same precedent exists in `organizations-plugin.ts#runMembershipPolicyGate`. The placement stays in `packages/objectql`, so no `needs_decision` is raised.

**Probe (one-off, not committed).** I moved the check into the engine's `kernel:ready` and removed it from `kernel:bootstrapped`. Class (a) still went red as expected. The three pins whose middleware is registered at a plugin's `kernel:ready` passed through unrefused: `3 failed | 5 passed (8)`. The restored blob equals `HEAD`. A first attempt at this probe was a no-op: `ablation-replace` refused it because the replacement contained its anchor. It was redone with a different anchor.

## Verification (head `0f5d9a6bc` after merging `origin/main` `06900c9c2`; the merge brings in no objectql file)

- New pins, `plugin-controlled-by-parent-unservable-master.test.ts`, run on a real `ObjectKernel` + `ObjectQLPlugin`, with the middleware registered from a plugin's `kernel:ready` the way the platform's own gates are:
  - class (a);
  - class (b);
  - class (b) over `sys_attachment`;
  - several offenders in one refusal.
  - Controls: HotCRM's six `controlled_by_parent` shapes (`e6d5d3e`), with a gated system object nobody masters on; global middleware (`*` / no object); both bound to one second datasource; a non-CBP detail across datasources. 8/8.
- **Ablation**: `if (unservable) throw unservable;` was replaced via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0). Result: `4 failed | 4 passed (8)`: the four class pins went red and the four controls stayed green. Restored, blob `2eccc2620e81` equals `HEAD`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- `@objectstack/objectql` typecheck: exit 0. Full suite: 461/461 files, 8645/8645 tests (on `e0ca492fd`).
- `@objectstack/runtime` full suite: 433/433 files, 6805 passed, 19 skipped (on `e0ca492fd`).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core test:repo`: 6/6 files, 82/82 tests.
- Dogfood battery (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`, full, under the lock, on `e0ca492fd`): `VERDICT command-exit 0`, Test Files 287 passed + 3 skipped (290), Tests 2395 passed + 18 skipped (2413). It boots the showcase, whose two `controlled_by_parent` objects are controls; the CRM example's `crm_opportunity_line_item` is covered by its suites.
- After the merge: full `turbo run build` (77/77), objectql typecheck and the new pins, all exit 0 on `0f5d9a6bc`.
- Derived gates: `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` lists 71 families. Every one was run with its exit code captured before any pipe, and `--ran` reconciles 71 derived, 71 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (no `dist/`) until the full build, then exited 0. `check:adr-0087-registration` passes: 1 declared-breaking changeset, `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Late installs.** A manifest registered *after* the boot (a marketplace install, or `metadata:reloaded`) is not judged by this rule. Its detail is still refused at read time by name (D5.2 / D5.3, unchanged). Judging it on arrival would mean resolving bindings for objects not yet registered. This card asked for the boot.
- **Reference alias.** The boot rule reads the master from the canonical `reference` key. plugin-security's CBP resolver also tolerates the rejected `reference_to` / `referenceTo` aliases on raw-registered objects. A raw-registered alias-spelled detail would boot here and still be refused at read.
- **Error code.** The refusal uses `INVALID_METADATA` / 422, like the sibling boot refusals (picklists, bound actions), not D3's `INTERNAL_ERROR` / 500. That envelope is a composition fault at read time; this is a declaration refused before anything is served.
- Not touched: `ObjectSchema.parse` / `packages/spec`, `os validate` (it resolves no deployment bindings or middleware registrations), and #24932's switch. #25092 and #25106 remain open.
